hel.desc: Hel (1.25x, tall): half violet-lit, half shadow; dark violet tunic, silver-belted skirt over leggings, grey mantle, carries the Ledger.

ferryman.desc: Corvin Lanternmere (ferryman, raven-keeper): long grey coat over a tunic, rope-belted trousers, a pole-lantern.

innghost.desc: Hettie Tallow (ghost innkeeper): faded apron over a rose tunic, belted skirt; feet fade into mist.

archivist_hh.desc: Quillon Greymarch (archivist): ink-stained tunic, belted trousers, spectacles, a quill behind his ear.

eira_spirit.desc: Eira Ashmantle (spirit, never fought): pale tunic, belted, cold-fire lantern; soft glowing outline = fx eira_outline.

childghost.desc: Hollin (child ghost, 0.8x): oversized tunic, rope belt, bare feet fading into mist; collects buttons.

bakerghost.desc: Old Marrow (baker ghost): flour-dusted tunic and apron, belted trousers.

sailorghost.desc: the ghost sailor (story 2, gs_sailor): faded blue tunic, belted trousers, knit cap.

gloam_folk.desc: Gloamhaven folk ghost (ambient 5.9): faded tunic, belted skirt over leggings, shawl.
